checkuser-global-contributions-no-result:
Message shown when the user has searched for a target account that doesn't exist.

Parameters:
* $1 - account username that was searched for
checkuser-global-contributions-link: Link anchor used on [[Special:Contributions]], [[Special:DeletedContributions]], [[Special:IPContributions]] and in user rows on Special:SuggestedInvestigations to see global contributions
checkuser-global-contributions-link-side: Link anchor used on the user pages' sidebar linking to Special:GlobalContributions. Text is similar to {{msg-mw|checkuser-global-contributions-link}}, with the difference being a capitalisation of the first character.
checkuser-global-contributions-summary:
Description of [[Special:GlobalContributions]] shown at the top of the page.

Parameters:
* $1 - The maximum number of days old that revisions can be in the results.
checkuser-global-contributions-permissio: Title of an error page shown if a user cannot access Special:GlobalContributions because they need to accept an agreement in their preferences
Contents of an error page shown if a user cannot access Special:GlobalContributions because they need to accept an agreement in their preferences
checkuser-global-contributions-subtitle:
Subtitle shown on Special:GlobalContributions that lets the user know that revisions shown on the page will not be more than a configurable number days ago old, and that a limited number of results are shown. Reminds the user that some wikis may be skipped due to the not having sufficient rights on these wikis.

Parameters:
* $1 - The maximum number of days old that revisions can be in the results.
* $2 - The maximum number of revisions displayed per wiki.
checkuser-global-contributions-subtitle-:
Subtitle shown on Special:GlobalContributions that lets the user know that revisions shown on the page will not be more than a configurable number days ago old, and that a limited number of results are shown.

Parameters:
* $1 - The maximum number of days old that revisions can be in the results.
* $2 - The maximum number of revisions displayed per wiki.
checkuser-global-contributions-target-la: Label for a field in the [[Special:GlobalContributions]] form
checkuser-global-contributions-target-pl: Placeholder for a field in the [[Special:GlobalContributions]] form
checkuser-global-contributions-search-fo: Legend for the search form on [[Special:GlobalContributions]]
checkuser-global-contributions-results-t:
Title of the search results page on [[Special:GlobalContributions]]

Parameters:
* $1 - IP address that was searched for
checkuser-global-contributions-no-result: Message shown when the user has no permissions to reveal IP addresses of temporary users at any recently active wikis, and there are no results

Message shown when the user needs to enable a global preference in order to reveal IP addresses of temporary users, and there are no results.

Parameters:
* $1 - URL for Special:GlobalPreferences on a wiki where the user has the right to reveal IP addresses of temporary accounts
checkuser-global-contributions-no-global:
Error message shown when the user needs to enable a global preference in order to reveal IP addresses of temporary users, but there are some results from wikis where they don't need the global preference.

Parameters:
* $1 - URL for Special:GlobalPreferences on a wiki where the user has the right to reveal IP addresses of temporary accounts
checkuser-global-contributions-api-looku: Error message shown if any API call made to an external wiki fails.
checkuser-global-contributions-no-result:
Message shown when the user has searched for a target account that has no contributions they can see.

Parameters:
* $1 - account username that was searched for
Message shown when the user has searched for a target and no results are displayed, but they have filters that would potentially hide some of the results (like a specified start and end date).
checkuser-global-contributions-page-when:
When a page displayed in [[Special:GlobalContributions]] is on another wiki and is in a namespace which is not a common namespace, this is displayed because we cannot get the translated namespace name from another wiki. This is intended to be removed once we can display the page name with it's namespace normally once it's technically possible to do. The message uses the {{msg-mw|namespace}} message with the namespace number included to allow a user to work out the namespace based on this.

Parameters:
* $1 - The namespace ID number for the page
* $2 - The page title without the namespace
checkuser-ipinfo-global-contributions-ur: Link text to user's global contributions list on IPInfo's infobox widget
checkuser-ipinfo-global-contributions-la: Label for global contributions property in IPInfo's infobox widget
checkuser-ipinfo-global-contributions-to: Description of the global contributions property in IPInfo's infobox widget
checkuser-ipinfo-global-contributions-va: Count of global contributions to be displayed in IPInfo's infobox widget
tooltip-t-global-contributions:
Tooltip for the [[Special:GlobalContributions]] link shown in the tool links bar for user pages.

Parameters:
* $1 - Name of the user
